claims.claim: Post-business-combination capital structure adds a concrete per-share dilution overhang distinct from operating burn: immediately after closing Infleqtion had 216,471,927 common shares and 10,424,967 warrants outstanding, while the PIPE itself issued 12,654,760 shares at $10 per share.

This dilution risk is not evidence of operating deterioration by itself; it is a financing/capital-structure sensitivity Alpha can incorporate when assessing how commercialization progress converts to per-share value.

risks.risk: Outstanding warrants and the enlarged post-combination share base create dilution sensitivity if additional equity-linked capital is used before operating cash generation becomes durable.

unknowns.unknown: Future warrant exercises, repurchases, equity issuance and the pace at which operating cash burn declines determine realized dilution; this evidence does not set Alpha's numeric risk score.
